name: Multi-file — file upload + search handler
diff:
diff --git a/upload_handler.go b/upload_handler.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/upload_handler.go
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+)
+
+func upload(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	name := r.URL.Query().Get("name")
+	path := filepath.Join("/uploads", name)
+	data, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+	f, _ := os.Create(path)
+	f.Write(data)
+	f.Close()
+}
diff --git a/search_handler.go b/search_handler.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/search_handler.go
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"database/sql"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+func search(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *sql.DB) {
+	kw := r.URL.Query().Get("q")
+	q := "SELECT * FROM items WHERE name LIKE '%" + kw + "%'"
+	client := &http.Client{}
+	resp, _ := client.Get("http://example.com/upstream?q=" + kw)
+	log := fmt.Sprintf("searching for %s", kw)
+	fmt.Println(log)
+	rows, err := db.Query(q)
+	rows.Close()
+}
